# Andrés Galdino

> Product Designer based in Bogotá, Colombia. Focused on UI/UX, design systems, visual identity, web animations, and logo motion. 8 years of professional experience building brands and digital interfaces. Available for remote work across Latin America and internationally.

## About

Andrés Galdino is a Product Designer with experience spanning brand identity, UI/UX product design, and creative direction. His work is grounded in structured design thinking and hands-on execution — from strategy and naming through final production and web implementation.

Primary tool: Figma. Additional tools: Adobe Illustrator, Notion, Unity (prototyping), AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini).

Languages: Spanish (native), Portuguese (fluent, available for projects in Brazil), English.

## Professional Experience

- **Chiper** — Designer within the product team. Contributed to visual communication and UI projects, including campaigns developed alongside Coca-Cola and other fast-moving consumer goods brands. Focus on DesignOps, visual scalability, and B2B product design across 4 Latin American markets.

- **Reserva Natural Victoria Regia** — Full brand identity project: naming system, visual identity, digital presence, and ongoing web management for an Amazonian nature reserve in Colombia.

- **Design Scalability** — Creation of look-and-feel design templates and reusable design systems for products launched simultaneously in Colombia, Brazil, and Mexico.

## Projects

- [Chiper](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/chiper.html): DesignOps and visual scalability for a B2B e-commerce platform, with campaigns involving Coca-Cola and other major brands.
- [Victoria Regia](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/victoria-regia.html): Brand identity, digital presence, and web management for an Amazonian nature reserve.
- [Amazonas Fashion Week](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/moda-week-international.html): Creative direction and brand design for the most significant fashion event in the Colombian Amazon.
- [FarmalaxIA](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/farmalaxia.html): Full brand identity for a pharmaceutical company integrating AI-assisted health services.
- [Dreams](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/dreams.html): UX/UI and motion design for a mobile app with cozy exploration and collectible creature mechanics.
- [LUMI](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/universitario.html): UX/UI case study for an emotional wellness and gamification app for young adults.
- [Museo](https://andresgaldino.com/paginas/proyectos/museo.html): Personal visual archive — photography, identity, design experiments, and creative exploration.

## Skills

UI/UX Design, Design Systems, Visual Identity, Brand Strategy, Logo Motion, Web Animation, Creative Direction, Figma, Adobe Illustrator, Motion Graphics, Interaction Design, Typography, Prototyping
